# What this page is

A language model assigns a probability to each next token, given the tokens already written. An *LLM* is that idea at scale, almost always sitting on a Transformer. The comparison table on the [Generative AI overview](generative-index.qmd) already names LLMs. For the architecture, see [Language model architecture](language-model-architecture.qmd) and [The evolution of attention](evolution-of-attention.qmd); for how the typist is trained and run, see [Language model training](language-model-training.qmd) and [Language model inference](language-model-inference.qmd).
